newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Mazatlan port closed to shipping.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Mazatlan port closed to shipping.

text.p: The port of Mazatlan was closed to all shipping on Friday as a result of Hurricane Fausto which has been threatening nearby Baja California, the port captain said.
Captain Roberto Lopez said operations at the port were suspended at 11 a.m. local time (1600 GMT) on Thursday.
He said the ferry service between Mazatlan, in the western state of Sinaloa, and La Paz, on the Baja California peninsula, was suspended.
The tourist and commercial port of Mazatlan is one of the most important shrimp and tuna distribution centers in the country.
